content: ClubSpark recurring coaching guide (2025-10-08) supports repeated weekly sessions, booking horizons, session coach/time/duration/capacity/cost defaults (https://sportlabs.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001052546-Creating-Recurring-Coaching-Sessions); its offline-payment guide (2025-11-19) documents payment instructions, unpaid roster state and admin amount/type recording (https://sportlabs.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020985977-Taking-Offline-Payments-for-Coaching-Courses-and-Sessions). TeamUp pending-offline guide (2026-06-16) documents a manual confirmation queue and received-date recording (https://support.goteamup.com/en/articles/9327466-confirming-cancelling-editing-and-managing-pending-offline-payments). Lafu should retain all approved recurring schedule, outside booking and payment functions in first release.
